title: Application Security and Privacy Review
learningObjectives: Explain the purpose and value of Application Security and Privacy Review.
Apply application security and privacy review to a Python project scenario.
Identify decisions and trade-offs relevant to application security and privacy review.
Review common mistakes and risks in application security and privacy review.
Produce a verifiable project artifact using application security and privacy review principles.

understand.concept: A security review examines assets, trust boundaries, threats, permissions, data collection, dependency exposure and failure handling. Privacy review asks whether personal data is necessary, how long it is retained, who can access it and how it can be deleted. Security is a continuous design and maintenance activity.
understand.whyItMatters: A structured review catches risks that ordinary feature testing may overlook.
understand.analogy: A building safety inspection checks entry points, restricted areas and emergency procedures.
understand.analogyLimit: A checklist cannot guarantee security; threat models and controls must be tested in the actual deployment context.
understand.summary: Application Security and Privacy Review helps learners deliver and maintain reliable Python projects.

explain.narrative: Identify valuable data and trust boundaries. Consider injection, unsafe deserialization, path traversal, command execution, weak secrets handling, excessive permissions and sensitive logs. Minimize collected data, define retention and access rules, update dependencies and document residual risks. Never treat client-side validation as authorization.

examples.title: Minimize collected data
examples.explanation: Collect only data needed for the purpose.

examples.title: Record residual risk
examples.explanation: Reviews should record both treatment and remaining exposure.

practise.guidedTask: Create a threat checklist for a file-upload feature without implementing unrestricted file access.
practise.independentTask: Review an API client for token leakage and excessive permissions.
hints: Keep credentials out of source and logs.
Apply least privilege and dependency updates.
practise.challenge: Write a security review with threats, mitigations, owners and residual risks.
validationCriteria: The project concept is accurately explained and applied.
All examples execute with documented output on Python 3.13.
The proposed artifact is testable and appropriate to requirements.
Operational, privacy and maintenance risks are acknowledged.
